At NC Digital, we build websites around those practical details: clear services, layouts that work on mobile and an obvious next step.

If your website makes getting in touch harder than it should be, we can help.

posts.topic: Give your website redesign a clear brief
posts.linkedin:
Thinking about a website redesign? Start with a short list of what needs to change.

Perhaps your main service is buried in the menu. Maybe the site still describes the business as it was five years ago. Or you've added new services that customers can't find anywhere on it.

Write those things down before getting into colours and layouts. They give the project a clear brief and something practical to check the finished website against.

At NC Digital, we plan the structure and content around your business before moving into the build. Get in touch if you're considering a change.
